{{Top|leg}}
'''Servo-controlled maneuvering adjusters''' were components found on [[Hoersch-Kessel Drive, Inc./Legends|Hoersch-Kessel Drive, Inc.'s]] [[Delaya-class courier|''Delaya''-class courier]]. Each adjuster mounted three of the [[Starship/Legends|vessel's]] twenty-one [[Hoersch-Kessel ion drive]]s.<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>
